import static android.app.WindowConfiguration.WINDOWING_MODE_FULLSCREEN;
import com.android.quickstep.GestureState.GestureEndTarget;
import com.android.quickstep.fallback.RoseEdgeGesture;
import com.android.quickstep.fallback.RoseEdgeSwipe;
import com.android.quickstep.util.MotionPauseDetector;
import com.android.quickstep.util.TaskViewSimulator;
import com.android.systemui.shared.recents.model.ThumbnailData;
import java.util.HashMap;
    // RoseOS (#410): the raised edge's staged gesture (tray, then switcher; a flick goes Home) and its live preview,
    // off unless persist.wm.debug.rose_edge.
    private final RoseEdgeSwipe mRoseEdge;
    private final Matrix mRoseMatrix = new Matrix();
    private final Rect mRoseCrop = new Rect();
    private final float[] mRoseRadius = new float[1];
    /** Launcher3's own motion-pause listener, driven by the switcher stage instead of the pause detector. */
    private MotionPauseDetector.OnMotionPauseListener mRoseStockPause;
    private boolean mRoseSwitcherEverShown;
    private final BuilderProxy mRosePreview = (builder, app, params) -> builder.setMatrix(mRoseMatrix)
            .setWindowCrop(mRoseCrop).setCornerRadius(mRoseRadius[0]);

        mRoseEdge = new RoseEdgeSwipe(context, displayId, mGestureState.getTopRunningTaskId(),
                mDeviceState.getTouchSlop(),
                mRunningOverHome || mGestureState.isTrackpadGesture() || continuingLastGesture
                        || !isRoseFullscreenTask(),
                mDeviceState.isFullyGesturalNavMode(), mDeviceState.isImeRenderingNavButtons());
    private boolean isRoseStaged() {
        return mRoseEdge != null && mRoseEdge.staged();
    }

    /**
     * RoseOS (#410): in a staged gesture the switcher is a stage (RoseEdgeGesture.SWITCHER), not Launcher3's motion
     * pause, so a slow drag reveals the tray instead of the switcher. The pause detector's events are dropped and
     * Launcher3's own listener is driven by the stage (updateDisplacement).
     */
    @Override
    public MotionPauseDetector.OnMotionPauseListener getMotionPauseListener() {
        MotionPauseDetector.OnMotionPauseListener stock = super.getMotionPauseListener();
        if (!isRoseStaged()) {
            return stock;
        }
        mRoseStockPause = stock;
        return () -> { };
    }

    /**
     * RoseOS (#410): each move updates the staged gesture: the tray is revealed with the finger (the edge window), the
     * tray stage is entered with a haptic, and the switcher stage visibly attaches Launcher3's switcher (as a pause did)
     * and detaches it again when the finger comes back down.
     */
    @Override
    public void updateDisplacement(float displacement) {
        super.updateDisplacement(displacement);
        if (!isRoseStaged()) {
            return;
        }
        int previous = mRoseEdge.stage();
        int stage = mRoseEdge.onMove(mCurrentDisplacement);
        if (stage == previous) {
            return;
        }
        boolean switcher = stage == RoseEdgeGesture.SWITCHER;
        if (switcher != (previous == RoseEdgeGesture.SWITCHER) && mRoseStockPause != null) {
            if (switcher && !mRoseSwitcherEverShown) {
                mRoseSwitcherEverShown = true;
                // Launcher3's first pause: attach recents to the app (the visible switcher) with its haptic.
                mRoseStockPause.onMotionPauseDetected();
            } else {
                if (switcher) {
                    performHapticFeedback();
                }
                maybeUpdateRecentsAttachedState(/* animate= */ true);
            }
            mRoseStockPause.onMotionPauseChanged(switcher);
        } else if (stage == RoseEdgeGesture.TRAY && previous == RoseEdgeGesture.NONE) {
            performHapticFeedback();
        }
    }

    /** RoseOS (#410): in a staged gesture, recents attaches exactly in the switcher stage (or for a quick switch). */
    @Override
    protected boolean isRecentsAttachRequested(
            boolean hasMotionEverBeenPaused, boolean isLikelyToStartNewTask) {
        if (!isRoseStaged()) {
            return super.isRecentsAttachRequested(hasMotionEverBeenPaused, isLikelyToStartNewTask);
        }
        return mRoseEdge.stage() == RoseEdgeGesture.SWITCHER || isLikelyToStartNewTask;
    }

    /**
     * RoseOS (#410): the staged release (RoseEdgeGesture.release): the switcher stage opens the switcher, a flick
     * before it goes Home, a release at the tray keeps the tray and shortens the app, anything else goes back to the
     * app. Launcher3's own cancel and horizontal quick switch stand.
     */
    @Override
    protected GestureEndTarget refineEndTarget(GestureEndTarget endTarget, boolean isCancel,
            boolean isMotionPaused, float endVelocityPxPerMs) {
        if (mRoseEdge == null || !mRoseEdge.enabled()) {
            return endTarget;
        }
        if (mGestureState.isHandlingAtomicEvent()) {
            mRoseEdge.settled(endTarget == GestureEndTarget.LAST_TASK);
            return endTarget;
        }
        GestureEndTarget refined = endTarget;
        if (endTarget == GestureEndTarget.NEW_TASK) {
            mRoseEdge.abandon();
        } else {
            switch (mRoseEdge.release(isCancel, endVelocityPxPerMs)) {
                case RoseEdgeGesture.RAISE:
                case RoseEdgeGesture.STAY:
                case RoseEdgeGesture.CANCEL:
                    refined = GestureEndTarget.LAST_TASK;
                    break;
                case RoseEdgeGesture.HOME:
                    refined = GestureEndTarget.HOME;
                    break;
                case RoseEdgeGesture.SWITCHER_OPEN:
                    refined = mDeviceState.isOverviewDisabled()
                            ? GestureEndTarget.LAST_TASK : GestureEndTarget.RECENTS;
                    break;
                default:
                    break;
            }
        }
        mRoseEdge.settled(refined == GestureEndTarget.LAST_TASK);
        return refined;
    }

    /** RoseOS (#410): a gesture that ends without a release still takes down the tray it revealed. */
    @Override
    public void onRecentsAnimationCanceled(HashMap<Integer, ThumbnailData> thumbnailDatas) {
        if (mRoseEdge != null) {
            mRoseEdge.abandon();
        }
        super.onRecentsAnimationCanceled(thumbnailDatas);
    }

    @Override
    public void onConsumerAboutToBeSwitched() {
        if (mRoseEdge != null) {
            mRoseEdge.abandon();
        }
        super.onConsumerAboutToBeSwitched();
    }

    /**
     * RoseOS (#410): while a staged gesture is outside the switcher stage, the app's own leash follows the tray at
     * full width (RoseEdgeSwipe.preview); in the switcher stage, for a quick switch or once the release goes Home or to
     * the switcher, Launcher3's transform as before.
     */
    @Override
    protected void applyTargetTransform(
            TaskViewSimulator taskViewSimulator, TransformParams transformParams) {
        if (!isRoseStaged()) {
            super.applyTargetTransform(taskViewSimulator, transformParams);
            return;
        }
        GestureEndTarget endTarget = mGestureState.getEndTarget();
        boolean attached = mRoseEdge.stage() == RoseEdgeGesture.SWITCHER || isLikelyToStartNewTask()
                || endTarget == GestureEndTarget.RECENTS || endTarget == GestureEndTarget.NEW_TASK
                || endTarget == GestureEndTarget.HOME;
        if (mDp == null || !mRoseEdge.preview(attached, mCurrentShift.value * mTransitionDragLength,
                mDp.getDeviceProperties().getWidthPx(), mDp.getDeviceProperties().getHeightPx(), mRoseMatrix,
                mRoseCrop, mRoseRadius)) {
            super.applyTargetTransform(taskViewSimulator, transformParams);
            return;
        }
        transformParams.applySurfaceParams(transformParams.createSurfaceParams(mRosePreview));
    }

    private boolean isRoseFullscreenTask() {
        TaskInfo task = mGestureState.getRunningTask() != null
                ? mGestureState.getRunningTask().getLegacyBaseTask() : null;
        return task != null && task.getWindowingMode() == WINDOWING_MODE_FULLSCREEN;
    }

        // RoseOS (#410): share Launcher3's identity with the home app, so it can verify that a gesture_nav_contract_v1
        // request really comes from the system recents component before it replies.
        ActivityOptions options = ActivityOptions.makeCustomAnimation(mContext, 0, 0)
                .setShareIdentityEnabled(true);
